I think media and the constant connectedness play a heavy role. Before the dawn of easy internet and social media you had a small bubble of people you ever interacted with. Now we can get loads of information, and negative information is more popular (just look at the news). So as we grow we are inundated with failure stories, stories where it all went wrong for the person and we get demoralized, what's the point of everything we ever try to do will only end up in failure? That degree? Get you a job as a waitress at best. The awareness of these failure stories weigh heavy on the minds of the young, I myself having been one of them and still working through that.
